{{Top|leg}}
'''Tiebo''' was the former [[valet]] of actress [[Rollo Morsai]]. After she was blacklisted by [[Babel Torsch]] and converted her yacht ''[[Gilded Lily]]'' to a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and started the life of a [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], Tiebo was hired as her [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="GG6.2">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref>
